brand.name: Readbit
brand.tagline: Read more. Learn better. Make every minute count.

landing.heroTitle: Your next great read, in less time.
landing.heroBody: Upload a book you own. Readbit turns it into faithful chapter summaries you can trust — every claim linked to the page it came from — and into short, adaptive lessons that help you remember what you read.
landing.how1Body: Add a PDF or EPUB from your computer or phone. Readbit reads its structure: chapters, sections and pages.
landing.how2Body: Choose a chapter and a depth. Summaries keep the author's reasoning, examples and caveats — with citations.
landing.how3Body: Four-option lessons, instant feedback and revision of weak concepts turn reading into lasting understanding.
landing.sumTitle: A summarizer that shows its sources
landing.sumBody: Every section of a Readbit summary points back to the passage that supports it. Tap a citation to see the original text and where it is in your book.
landing.sumPoint2: Central thesis, arguments, examples and caveats
landing.sumPoint3: Ask questions answered only from your book
landing.quizTitle: A quizzer that adapts to you
landing.quizBody: Lessons follow your book chapter by chapter. Questions get harder as you improve and easier when you struggle — and weak concepts come back for revision.
landing.quizPoint1: Exactly four options, one validated answer
landing.quizPoint2: The correct answer and the supporting passage, every time
landing.exampleIntro: An illustration using a short sample passage written for this page.
landing.exampleSourceText: Attention is the scarcest resource a reader owns. Every interruption spends part of it before real work begins — a cost the author calls the switching tax.
landing.exampleSummaryText: The author treats attention as a limited budget: each interruption carries a “switching tax” paid before focus returns.
landing.exampleQuizQ: What does the author call the cost of an interruption?
landing.trustTitle: Private by default. Grounded by design.
landing.trust1Body: Uploads are stored privately, never shared or published, and never used to train AI models. Delete a book — or your account — at any time.
landing.trust2Body: Summaries, answers and quiz explanations use only your uploaded book. When the book doesn't cover something, Readbit says so instead of guessing.
landing.trust3Body: If a page couldn't be read or chapters weren't detected reliably, you'll see it. AI-generated content is always labelled.
landing.faq1A: DRM-free PDF and EPUB files of books you have the right to use. Scanned PDFs need OCR, which may not be enabled on every server.
landing.faq2Q: Does Readbit replace reading the book?
landing.faq2A: No. It helps you get more out of limited time and review what you read. The original book remains the full, authoritative work.
landing.faq3Q: Can I use Readbit without an account?
landing.faq3A: Yes. Guest sessions let you try everything; guest books are deleted automatically after the retention period. Create an account to keep your library.
landing.faq4A: The interface is available in English and Hindi. Summaries and lessons are produced in your book's language, and in other supported languages when a translation-capable AI engine is configured.
landing.footerNote: Readbit is a reading and learning aid. It does not replace the original publication.
